*"The function $g$ maps the set $X$ to the set of real numbers."*

feedback.problem:
Which of the following is the correct symbolic notation for the sentence given below?

*"The function $f$ maps the set of real numbers to the set containing the two numbers $0$ and $1$ only"*
feedback.worked_solution:
The sentence *"The function $f$ maps the set of real numbers to the set containing the two numbers $0$ and $1$ only"* is equivalent to the following symbolic notation:

$\,$ $f:R\to {0,1}$

Here, the domain of $f$ is $R,$ and the codomain of $f$ is ${0,1}.$
